storage: Keep sealed at room temperature for 3 to 4 days; in hot humid Mumbai weather it moulds faster, so refrigerate or freeze slices (up to about 2 months) and toast from frozen.
looksLike: A soft, square, white loaf, sliced into even slices, usually sold in 350–700 g packs (a 400 g pack holds about 14 to 16 slices of about 25 g).
howToPick: Check the pack date and choose the freshest loaf; the loaf should be soft and spring back, with no mould spots or sour smell. Check the label: maida is usually the first ingredient.
shelfLife: Usually 3 to 5 days at room temperature from the pack date, longer in the fridge or freezer (general guidance; follow the label).
substitutes: Brown / atta bread or multigrain bread
